Name: Garlic Sauce
Instructions: Mince the garlic and saute it in olive oil. Add salt, pepper, and herbs to taste. Serve as a simple garlic sauce.

Name: Coconut Milkshake
Instructions: Blend coconut milk with sugar and vanilla extract. Add ice and blend until smooth. Serve chilled.

Name: Thyme Cookies
Instructions: Mix thyme with sugar, butter, flour, and eggs. Bake in a preheated oven until golden brown. Serve warm.

Name: Mushroom Stew
Instructions: Combine celery and mushrooms in a pot. Add water and simmer for 20 minutes.

Name: Pepper Omelet
Instructions: Whisk eggs with black pepper. Pour into a pan and cook until set.
